problem_statement: Build a brand-new Integrations page from scratch at the /integrations route of this Vue 3 + Vuetify (Modernize) admin template. The route does not exist yet (it currently falls through to the 404 view). Construct the full static page inside the existing FullLayout shell (sidebar + topbar), reusing the site's Vuetify design system (v-card/v-row/v-col/v-btn, the primary color tokens, vue-tabler-icons). The page presents the product's third-party connectors: a hero, a catalog of available integrations, why-connect benefits, a how-it-works walkthrough, and a closing call to action. Static content only, no interaction. Keep it typesafe (build runs vue-tsc --noEmit).
required_content: Hero card (primary background) with an h3 'Connect Nexus Analytics' and an intro paragraph

'Available Integrations' section (h3) with a catalog of connector cards (Slack, GitHub, Google Workspace, Stripe, Mailchimp, Amazon S3), each with a tabler icon, an h3 name, a category label and a description paragraph
'Why Connect Your Tools' section (h3) with three benefit cards (Secure by default / Set up in minutes / Always in sync)
'How It Works' section (h3) with a numbered three-step walkthrough
Closing CTA card (primary background) with an h3 and a 'Browse the catalog' button
design_constraints: Reuse Vuetify components (v-card, v-card-item, v-row/v-col, v-btn) and the template's primary color tokens (bg-primary/text-primary)
Use vue-tabler-icons for the connector and benefit icons
Mount inside the existing FullLayout shell as a child route (sidebar + topbar), like the other pages
Section headings must be real <h3> elements; keep the component typesafe so vue-tsc --noEmit passes
No new interaction / state; the page is static
